fee_details:
- First Year Membership Fee: Rs. 999 + applicable taxes
- Renewal Fee: Rs.999 + applicable taxes (If Rs.2 lakh is spent previous year)
- Foreign currency markup charge: 2.35% on the transaction amount
joining_perks: This card offers a host of benefits that include reward points and offers complimentary airport access, golf program, and many more.
reward_structure:
- On every Rs.100 spent on online shopping, offline shopping and other selected categories, cardholders will earn 12, 6 and 2 reward points respectively.
- For statement cycle, cardholders can earn a maximum of 12,000 reward points.
key_highlights:
- YES Bank ELITE credit card comes with multiple features and exclusive offers including rewards, cashback, and many more.
- Offers reward points on online shopping.

benefits_features.Travel benefits:
International airport lounge access for both Visa and Mastercard users.
- Two domestic airport lounge access will be offered per calendar quarter in India.
- For primary cardmember, two domestic airport lounges will be offered per calendar quarter in India.
benefits_features.Fuel benefits: On every fuel transaction of value greater than Rs. 10,000, 3,100 plus applicable GST will be applicable.
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: Rs.999 plus applicable taxes (if Rs.2 lakh is spent previous year)
benefits_features.Lounge benefits: International airport lounges offered for Visa and Master card users

how_tos.Redemption of reward points: You would have to pay a fee of Rs. 100 for the redemption of reward points accumulated on your YES Bank ELITE Credit Card.

reward_point_benefits:
- Reward points will not be offered for cash/ fuel withdrawal transactions and on transactions are converted into EMI.
- YES Bank reward points are equal to Club Vistara Points or Paytm Points.

fees_and_charges.Interest rate: For YES Bank ELITE Credit Card, the interest rate that is levied on the overdue amount, cash advance or revolving credit is 3.00% per month (36% per year).
fees_and_charges.Utility charges:
On spends above Rs.15,000 in a month, 1.00% plus applicable GST (Goods and Services Tax) will be levied on all utility transactions.
Note: Fee capped per calendar month is Rs.3000.
fees_and_charges.Education payment Charges:
On every fuel transaction of value greater than Rs. 10,000, 3,100 plus applicable GST will be applicable.
Note: Total Fuel Transaction charges capped per calendar month is Rs.3000 per customer.

miscellaneous: YES Bank ELITE credit card provides complimentary airport access, golf program, cashback, and many more. There is a list of features and benefits of YES Bank ELITE credit card.

faqs.Is there a maximum limit for the cashbac: Yes, the maximum fuel transaction waiver in a billing cycle cannot exceed Rs.3,500.
faqs.Should I pay reward redemption fee when: Yes, you will have to pay a fee of Rs. 100 while you request the redemption of reward points.
faqs.What is the interest rate that is levied: For YES Bank ELITE Credit Card, the interest rate that is levied on the overdue amount, cash advance or revolving credit is 3.00% per month (36% per year).
faqs.Is there any processing fee involved if: No processing fees are involved if you avail of the YES Bank ELITE Credit Card.
faqs.Does YES Bank ELITE credit card offer ai: Yes, YES Bank ELITE + credit card provides international airport lounge access to cardholders. Primary cardholders are offered with two domestic airport lounge visits per calendar quarter while international airport lounge access is provided to Visa and Mastercard cardholders.
faqs.Can I waive my annual membership fee for: Yes, you can waive off your renewal charges for YES Bank ELITE + credit cards on total spends of Rs.2 lakh in a year.
faqs.Will I have to pay any additional charge: Yes, for the utility spends more than Rs. 15,000 in a month, you will have to pay an additional charge of 1.00% plus GST (Goods and Service Tax).
